Container.Name: scan-stack-splitter
Container.Overview: Splits scanned PDF stacks (hundreds of pages, no separator sheets) into individual documents by content, names each one by topic and date, and writes searchable PDFs. A second input takes files from a document scanner (one document per file, no splitting) and gives them the same OCR and naming. Each input has its own inbox/ and output/ (sub-folders are mirrored). Uses Mistral OCR via the batch API and a Mistral chat model; the text layer comes from a fresh Tesseract pass. No web UI: progress is in the container log, a review.md per stack lists uncertain splits in the work folder. Needs a Mistral API key. If the image is private, Unraid needs a one-time `docker login ghcr.io` before the first pull.

Config.Name: Stacks
Config.Description: Large scans to split. inbox/, output/, archive/ and failed/ are created here.

Config.Name: Scanner
Config.Description: Scanner input, one document per file. Point the scanner's network-folder target at inbox/ below this path.

Config.Name: Work
Config.Description: Per-stack OCR text, plan.json, review.md and temporary page images (several GB while a large stack is processed). Holds full document text: delete stacks you no longer need.

Config.Name: MISTRAL_MAX_RPS
Config.Description: Requests per second, slightly below your account's limit for MISTRAL_LLM_MODEL (Mistral admin panel: API > Limits)

Config.Name: TITLE_LANGUAGE
Config.Description: Language for document titles, e.g. German. Empty: the language of each document.

Config.Name: NO_DATE_LABEL
Config.Description: Used in the file name when a document has no date

Config.Name: OCRMYPDF_JOBS
Config.Description: CPU cores for the Tesseract text layer

Config.Name: QUEUE_WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional: POST queue counts here on every change and every 5 minutes, e.g. a Home Assistant webhook (http://HA:8123/api/webhook/ID). See the project README for the sensor config.

Config.Name: OCR_MODE
Config.Description: batch: half price, minutes per job. direct: immediate, full price.

Config.Name: TMPDIR
Config.Description: Temporary page images go to disk instead of RAM
